visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video features a split-screen format. The top half shows a 3D platforming game with three avatars (male characters in green, purple, and blue shirts) navigating a reddish-brown, underworld-themed environment filled with large skull statues and chains. The bottom half shows a man in a black beanie and black hoodie sitting in a gaming studio, reacting with a wide smile. (2) The game characters jump onto rotating stone platforms inscribed with red symbols. In the bottom panel, a woman in a green sweater and a man with glasses appear alongside the first man. They are all looking at the screen with intense expressions, laughing and pointing. (3) The scene shifts to the characters attempting to climb a rope ladder next to a wall of moving spikes. The studio members are seen shouting and laughing; the woman covers her eyes momentarily. (4) The characters are shown jumping across large floating wooden crates and mechanical wheels over a foggy red abyss. One character falls, and the man in the beanie reacts by opening his mouth in a silent 'O' shape. (5) A new segment shows the characters inside a red, open-top vehicle driving on a precarious track. The studio members are shown together, leaning into each other while laughing. (6) The vehicle falls off the edge of the track into the void. The camera focuses on the woman in the green sweater who is laughing hysterically and waving her hands in a 'stop' motion.

(4) Male voice shouting '救命' (Help) with high vocal arousal and strain. BGM volume swells slightly to emphasize the chaos.
